_doc: 6 Phong Cách Đạo Diễn Viral (Director Archetypes — Vòng 13, vidlib/narratives.py). Mỗi archetype khóa đồng bộ 5 trục: cấu trúc kể chuyện (narrative_default + arc_rules), bộ beat hình ảnh giàu chiều sâu (required_beats), ngữ pháp camera 3D (camera_presets), chuyển cảnh agency (transitions), bản sắc âm thanh (music_mood) và kiểu kết (outro_mode). Xoay vòng theo lịch sử kênh với avoid_recent: 4 để 5 video liền kề không bao giờ trùng khuôn.

visceral_anatomy.name: Giải phẫu cận cảnh & nhân-quả sinh lý
visceral_anatomy.arc_rules: Cold-open at frame 0 on an extreme physical close-up already in motion (0–2s, zero lecture intro). Dive directly inside the body or object through a 3-layer physiological But/Therefore chain (trigger → internal mechanism → unexpected systemic consequence). Re-hook at 12–16s by diving one anatomical layer deeper with an iris_match into xray_cutaway. End on a seamless loop whose final clause flows directly back into shot 1's opening hook.

forensic_dossier.name: Hồ sơ điều tra & bằng chứng
forensic_dossier.arc_rules: Open with a calm, chilling real-world paradox stated as cold fact (0–2s). Lay out Evidence #1 and Evidence #2 via archival dossier cards and sharp data graphs, using But/Therefore pivots to demolish the obvious explanation around 12–16s (mid-video re-hook). Unveil the 'smoking gun' mechanism in dramatic low-key 3D spotlight (low_hero) and loop back smoothly into the opening paradox.

editorial_clash.name: Đối đầu dữ liệu & biên tập tạp chí
editorial_clash.arc_rules: Put two opposing forces, methods, or contenders head-to-head at frame 0. Run 3 crisp data-driven rounds using architectural hero_stat callouts and compare/split visuals, where each round flips the lead via But/Therefore tension. Trigger a decisive mid-video upset at 12–16s with a whip_match into 3D over_shoulder action, then deliver an unexpected hidden-cost payoff.

ticking_clock.name: Đồng hồ đếm ngược áp lực leo thang
ticking_clock.arc_rules: Anchor the entire short to a relentless escalating metric (time, core temperature, heart rate, or fuel remaining) using a persistent top-level story_hud across every shot. Advance through tight time/threshold stamps (e.g., 00:00 → 00:10 → 01:00 → breaking point) where each milestone compounds stress via But/Therefore causality. Hit the mid-video threshold crack at 12–16s with an iris_match and 3D dolly_zoom, build to the breaking-point payoff, and loop cleanly back to 00:00.

myth_autopsy.name: Mổ xẻ lầm tưởng & phản chứng
myth_autopsy.arc_rules: Open by stating the universally believed myth with straight-faced authority (0–2.5s), then violently interrupt it with a tape_stop transition and hard counter-evidence. Dissect why the myth feels true via dossier evidence and xray_cutaway mechanics, deploy a second twist at 12–16s showing the real hidden mechanism in 3D low_hero, and loop the closing line back so the opening myth now sounds ironic.

one_object_odyssey.name: Hành trình một chủ thể (One-Shot Match Cut)
one_object_odyssey.arc_rules: Lock onto ONE unmistakable hero object (a single drop, sip, carb gel, shoe strike, nerve pulse, or packet) and carry it continuously across 100% of shots as its surrounding world transforms. Chain consecutive shots with iris_match and whip_match graphic match cuts so the short feels like one unbroken camera ride. Trigger a dramatic scale/world shift at 12–16s (e.g., 3D tracking_low diving straight into 2D xray_cutaway) and loop the final state seamlessly back into shot 1.
